subject: Unexpected tenant-tagging spike & VAT allocation — please advise
messages:
From: Gina Harper <billing@utilityco.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Finance AP <ap@utilityco.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Oct 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Unusual usage spike on October invoice — tenant tagging?

Hi Tessa,

We noticed a large, unexpected token spike on our October consumption line (35,412 tokens) that appears to be attributed to the 'prod-main' billing entity on your invoice. Our engineering team is confident that recent activity should have been limited to the 'staging-utility' project (sandbox keys), and the prod project only had a few low-volume calls.

Can you help explain:
- Why tokens were attributed to the prod entity when our staging prefix should have billed to a different account?
- Whether this affects VAT treatment for our EU entity (we will need the invoice lines split by entity to confirm reverse-charge handling).

Please put the October invoice on hold while you investigate — we will withhold payment for the disputed amount until this is resolved. Attached is a quick screenshot from our telemetry showing the session IDs we think are related.

Thanks — we need this turned around quickly for month-end close.

Best,
Gina Harper
Senior Financial Ops
UtilityCo

Attachments: utilityco_session_ids_10-14.png (image/png)
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Gina Harper <billing@utilityco.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 14 Oct 2026 10:05:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Unusual usage spike on October invoice — tenant tagging?

Hi Gina — thanks for the heads-up and the screenshot. I put your October invoice on temporary hold this morning (collection hold flag set, notes added) and opened an internal investigation (ticket PRB-9872).

Quick asks to speed the audit:
- Can you confirm the Redwood Account ID and HubSpot company record (if available)?
- If possible, paste 3 example session IDs from the screenshot into a reply — that will let us trace the tokens through ingestion and attribution.

Next steps from our side: Ben (cc'd) will validate whether this is an attribution prefix/tagging issue or a genuine production call. Lauren (cc'd) will scope implications for VAT lines if the consumption needs to be reallocated across entities.

I will follow up within 24 hours with the preliminary findings and a proposed credit if we confirm misattribution.

Sorry for the disruption — we'll prioritize this for you.

Regards,
Tessa Morgan
Account Lead, Billing Escalations
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 14 Oct 2026 11:20:45 -0700
Subject: Internal: UtilityCo tenant-split — first pass

Tessa / Lauren — quick note while I'm triaging PRB-9872. I pulled the ingestion logs for UtilityCo and see a batch of calls on 2026-10-12 02:14:xx UTC with a prefix that was updated in our tagging table on 2026-09-30. Two possible causes:

1) Staging API key got promoted or a prefix mapping changed during the release on 9/30; those calls were routed to the prod billing namespace.
2) A misconfigured client-side SDK (common pattern we saw in other customer cases) that sends a 'namespace' header that doesn't match the portal mapping.

I recommend:
- Short-term: offer a provisional credit for the disputed tokens (I ran numbers — at their current plan $1,420 seems reasonable) and mark the credit as conditional pending full forensic logs.
- Technical: ops can export the full request/response traces for the session IDs Gina will provide; we should confirm whether the calls were authenticated with a prod key.
- VAT: if the usage truly belongs to UtilityCo's EU entity we should reverse-charge and remove VAT from the prod invoice line. Lauren, can you confirm whether finance needs a separate credit memo for the EU entity?

I can draft the provisional credit note and push to collections if you want to proceed now to avoid disrupting their month-end.

—Ben
Billing Lead, Redwood Inference

On Thu, 14 Oct 2026 at 10:05 AM Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Gina — thanks for the heads-up...
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Gina Harper <billing@utilityco.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Oct 2026 16:30:07 -0700
Subject: Resolution: tenant-tagging misattribution + provisional credit issued

Gina — update and next steps. TL;DR: we confirmed misattribution and issued a provisional credit; VAT treatment updated.

Root cause summary:
- Forensic logs show the disputed calls (session IDs you provided) used a prefix that had been remapped to 'prod-main' by an internal deployment on 2026-09-30. The calls were authenticated with your staging key, but the upstream tagging mapping routed them to the prod billing namespace. That mismatch caused the tokens to be counted on the prod invoice line.

What we did:
- Placed your October invoice on collection hold (you should see the hold flag in the console).
- Issued a provisional credit of $1,420 against invoice INV-20261004 (credit note attached). This amount reflects the disputed tokens at your contracted per-token rate.
- Adjusted the VAT lines: the disputed consumption has been reallocated to your EU entity for VAT reporting. We will issue a corrected invoice line showing the reverse-charge (zero VAT) treatment for the EU entity.
- Attached: usage_snapshot_20261014.csv (full export for the sessions in question) and provisional_credit_note_UTL-4321.pdf.

Next steps / timeline:
- Ops will follow up with a full ingestion export (already uploaded here: https://redwood.internal/ledger/exports/UTL-4321-20261014).
- We will finalize the credit within 5 business days once you confirm receipt of the usage export and that the session list matches your records.
- Finance will issue the corrected invoice and final credit memo for your accounting team (Lauren will coordinate).

If you prefer an immediate reversal instead of a provisional credit, we can fast-track it — let me know and I'll escalate to finance to do the final settlement today.

Apologies for the trouble; we've scheduled a config review with the infra team to prevent this remapping from happening again.

Cheers,
Tessa Morgan
Account Lead, Billing Escalations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: usage_snapshot_20261014.csv (text/csv); provisional_credit_note_UTL-4321.pdf (application/pdf)
